svg.title: Велосипед на улице — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two complete side-view diagrams of road cycling on a normal outdoor bicycle with two large spoked wheels, chain, frame, saddle, handlebars. Rider seated, helmet, both feet on pedals. Left right pedal low, right figure right pedal high and opposite pedal low. No stationary base. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
